about: Golden vectors of loadRunnerConfigForDir over the documents the config door reads. A load vector is { name, root, door: { runner, origins }, expect } and a refusal vector is { name, root, door: { refused: { code, message, refusals }, checkFindings }, expect }; expect is { ok: { config, origins } } or { error: { name, category, code?, phase?, message, path?, paths?, detail? } }. $ROOT is the directory the project lives under; the attributed file path is the project root joined onto .fgos. Recorded by test/golden-recorders/core-runner-config.recorder.mjs; the Rust loader is the owner now.

vectors.name: an empty runner section loads as an empty config
a runner section with a default executor loads unchanged and carries its origins
legacy confinement flags on the default executor become a policy and keep the backend
legacy short-form flags on a named executor become a policy
a controls-only confinement is filled with the policy defaults, grants from a private home
a controls-only confinement keeps its own grants and backend
a policy already in the v1 shape stays as it is
a confinement with no flags and no controls is left alone
a global runner.rigorToTier names the global file with line and column
